## Goal

Make `/historie` the strongest page: complete, filterable, mobile-friendly, losses as visible as wins.

## Context

Components exist: `CumulativeChart`, `HistoryFilters`, `TipsTable`, `TrackRecordFigures`.

## Scope

- Apply design rules 46 to 61.
- URL-state filters.
- Mobile two-line row layout.
- Text alternative for the chart.

## Out of scope

- Changing settlement or statistics logic in `src/lib/tips`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Unit tests for any new formatting.
- [ ] Visual check at 375/1280 px.
- [ ] No row is hidden by default filters.

## Required tests

- Standard checks.
- Playwright: losing tip visible to anonymous visitor.

## Dependencies

- SC-005

## Priority

P2 · Phase A

## Agent

Claude Code
